title: 第9章 深夜围杀第10章 初展锋芒深夜杀戮
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
月明星稀。
江尘静静坐在一旁。
缓慢喝着杯中之酒。
……
不知不觉间。
江尘已经在阁楼中待了几个时辰，小灵送来的一壶酒也被喝得差不多了。
抬头看了一眼不远处的上官明月，江尘缓慢从座位上站了起来。
开口说道：“明月小姐，江某还有些事情要处理，今天就不叨扰了。”
上官明月微微一愣。
而后柔声回应：“也好，那我就不多留江公子了，希望我们还能再见面。”
随着上官明月话音落下。
江尘快速转身朝阁楼外走去，上官明月来到窗台前，看着不断朝山下走去的江尘。
眼眸中露出了一抹复杂之色。
……
江尘走后不久。
小灵再次走了进来。
看着窗台前的上官明月，眼中露出了一抹好奇，快速来到她的身前。
开口询问道：“小姐，怎么样，江公子是你要找的人吗？”
上官明月轻轻点了点头。

随后又摇了摇头。
看到这一幕。
小灵眼眸中露出了浓浓的疑惑之色。
上官明月：“是，也不是，他是一个很特别的人，我看不透他。”
话音落下。
上官明月将目光投向一旁的桌面上，那上面还放着一张纸条。
正是江尘写的水调歌头。
小灵察觉到这一点。
缓慢将那张纸条给拿了起来，当看清楚上面写的内容后，眼中露出了震惊之色。
上官明月：“走吧，该回去了！”
“嗯！”
应答一声后。
小灵将纸张对折好，快速交到上官明月手中，而后两人一同离开了阁楼。
……
此时。
虽是午夜时分。
天香楼外却还聚集了不少人，他们眼巴巴看着江尘进入的阁楼。
眼中满是不甘之色。
“哎，这都过去好几个时辰了，江尘竟然还没从里屋出来，真是艳福不浅啊。”
“话说，江二少一个不学无术之人，竟然能写出此等有意境的诗词，真是太让人匪夷所思，难道他一直在隐藏不成？”

……
“这哪是什么隐藏，我看就是瞎猫碰上死耗子而已。”
content_en:
………………
The moon and stars are sparse.
Jiang Chen sat quietly aside.
Sip the wine slowly.
…
Unknowingly.
Jiang Chen has been staying in the attic for several hours, and has almost finished the bottle of wine that Xiao Ling brought.
After looking up at Shangguan Mingyue not far away, Jiang Chen slowly stood up from his seat.
He said, "Miss Mingyue, Jiang still has some things to deal with, so I won't bother you today."
Shangguan Mingyue was slightly startled.
Then he responded softly: "Okay, then I won't keep Mr. Jiang any longer. I hope we can meet again."
As Shangguan Mingyue finished speaking.
Jiang Chen quickly turned around and walked out of the attic. Shangguan Mingyue came to the window sill and looked at Jiang Chen who kept walking down the mountain.
There was a complex look in his eyes.
…
Not long after Jiang Chen left.
Xiao Ling walked in again.
Looking at Shangguan Mingyue in front of the window sill, there was a hint of curiosity in his eyes, and he quickly came to her.
He opened his mouth and asked, "Miss, how are you? Is Mr. Jiang the person you are looking for?"
Shangguan Mingyue nodded slightly.
Then he shook his head again.
See this scene.
Xiao Ling's eyes showed deep doubts.
Shangguan Mingyue: "Yes and no. He is a very special person. I can't see through him."
The words fell.
Shangguan Mingyue turned her gaze to the table aside, where there was a note.
It was the water-melody song that Jiang Chen wrote.
Xiaoling noticed this.
He slowly picked up the note, and when he saw clearly what was written on it, his eyes showed a look of shock.
Shangguan Mingyue: "Let's go, it's time to go back!"
"Yeah!"
After a reply.
Xiao Ling folded the paper in half and quickly handed it to Shangguan Mingyue, and then the two of them left the attic together.
……
at this time.
Even though it was midnight.
However, many people gathered outside Tianxiang Tower, and they eagerly watched Jiang Chen enter the attic.
His eyes were full of unwillingness.
"Hey, it's been several hours, and Jiang Chen hasn't come out of the back room yet. What a blessing."
"Speaking of which, it's really incredible that Er Shao Jiang, an unlearned and incompetent person, can write such artistic poetry. Could it be that he has been hiding it all this time?"
…
"What kind of hiding is this? I think it's just a blind cat meeting a dead mouse."
